blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing ZARm token has no direct governance-controlled blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Broker/exchange burn and Celo-VM gas debiting are protocol-scoped, not governance holder-freeze controls. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is a governance surface but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole registered ZARm deployment is Celo 0x4c35853a3b4e647fd266f4de678dcc8fec410bf6; the 2026-10-19 Pharos supply census assigns Celo 100% of circulation, so its controls are material against the 10% threshold. At Celo block 80489704 (2026-10-19T06:14:22Z; hash 0x42bb9d8457a53082b049e0fed7918070b4c9523bc772880c172d4337cf2c9ebf), the EIP-1967 implementation was 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e and the proxy admin and token owner() were the nonzero Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. The proxy exposes owner-gated _setImplementation(address) and _setAndInitializeImplementation(address,bytes). Both proxy and StableTokenV2 runtime matched their verified source bytecode at the pinned block. The Timelock implementation was 0x3efad8f997f705675924470ec84677db68c5a2d0, its runtime matched the verified TimelockController, and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. At the same pinned block, timelock hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE 0xb09aa5aeb3702cfd50b6b62bc4532604938f21248a27a1d5ca736082b6819cc1, Governor 0x47036d78bb3169b4f5560dd77bf93f4412a59852) returned true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE 0xd8aa0f3194971a2a116679f7c2090f6939c8d4e01a2a8d7e41d55e5351469e63, address(0)) returned true (open execution). Governor.timelock() returned 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, closing a live governance scheduling and execution path rather than assuming a nonzero but unusable admin. This admin-upgradeable token is direct Possible even when the administrator is DAO governance and changes wait two days; the DAO-only exclusion applies to collateral, not the token itself. The current StableTokenV2 implementation has ordinary transfer/transferFrom and no blacklist, holder freeze, global transfer pause, seizure, allowlist or arbitrary-holder administrative burn. broker() returned 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators() 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and exchange() zero. Permissioned burn(uint256) burns msg.sender only, mint authority increases balances, and debitGasFees(address,uint256) is restricted to the zero-address VM rather than a privileged issuer holder, so these do not establish Yes. Neither variantOf nor mintAuthority.inheritedFrom declares a parent. The issuer reserve API observed 2026-10-19T06:16Z reports collateral.total_usd of $16,826,760.601825558 and asset weights summing to 100%. Against that complete collateral denominator, issuer stablecoins excluding sUSDS alone account for 58.2518%; counting the full 28.0181% sUSDS leg categorically through USDS gives 86.2698%. CELO, stETH and ETH/WETH are excluded from the numerator. This is the issuer collateral.assets denominator, not gross holdings plus separately reported LP/operational portfolios. This ancillary majority does not displace the direct Possible verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, ZARm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/ZARm ConstantSum exchange 0x4206e101b13bf29e40b2bfed4cf167271c41677720f2ee786ac1bf5efac101cb uses ZAR/USD feed 0x17ef04af0c52465694a841552fc2415169b1114c, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0x4ff9042af59af2b507b9423be385f664ff87f7af, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0x11b7221a0dd025778a95e9e0b87b477522c32e02. getRates and medianRate agree on 59931680000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887082. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 0.3%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. The sorted-list median of one relayer is not independent medianization or failover. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. This evidenced single-live-source topology retains the existing Mento single-source-or-laggy convention; it does not assert the pinned report was stale.

branchApplicability.rationale: ZARm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
